newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ASTON VILLA'S BOSNICH SUFFERS ANOTHER INJURY SETBACK.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ASTON VILLA'S BOSNICH SUFFERS ANOTHER INJURY SETBACK.

text.p: Aston Villa goalkeeper Mark Bosnich underwent knee surgery on Monday and was expected to be out of action for a month.
The Australian suffered ligament damage in Saturday's 1-0 defeat by Sunderland in an English premier league match after falling awkwardly when collecting a cross.
Bosnich missed the first two months of the season after injuring the same knee.

It is the latest setback in an unhappy spell for Bosnich who was charged by the Football Association for giving a Hitler-style salute to Tottenham Hotspur fans in his first appearance of the season earlier this month. The Australian is still waiting to see if he will be charged by police over the incident.
